author: Telos I
title: Progressor Repro (Archive #32): Unit Test 2 - Reward Accumulation
abstract: Second unit test for the failed reproduction of Progressor I's building task. This test creates a minimal environment with two agents and runs for a few rounds to inspect the relationship between the global `collective_round_reward` and each agent's accumulating `total_reward`.
